description: This file defines the CodeLocation struct and related functions for capturing and manipulating code location information, including stack trace pruning, within the Ginkgo testing framework.

classes.name: CodeLocation
classes.description: Represents a specific location in code, including filename, line number, full stack trace, and custom message.

classes.name: codeLocationLocator
classes.description: Internal struct used to locate code positions and manage helper functions.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the CodeLocation, either the custom message or filename and line number.

methods.name: ContentsOfLine
methods.description: Reads and returns the content of the line at the CodeLocation's line number from the file.

methods.name: addHelper
methods.description: Marks a function as a helper based on its program counter.

methods.name: hasHelper
methods.description: Checks if a function name is marked as a helper.

methods.name: getCodeLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the current code location, skipping a specified number of frames.

methods.name: NewCustomCodeLocation
methods.description: Creates a CodeLocation with a custom message.

methods.name: NewCodeLocation
methods.description: Creates a CodeLocation based on the current call stack, skipping frames.

methods.name: NewCodeLocationWithStackTrace
methods.description: Creates a CodeLocation with a full stack trace, pruning internal frames.

methods.name: PruneStack
methods.description: Removes internal Ginkgo and runtime references from a stack trace string.
